newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick confirms talks with Bre-X.
newsitem.headline: Barrick confirms talks with Bre-X.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp confirmed on Tuesday that it was negotiating with Bre-X Minerals Ltd about Bre-X's huge Busang gold deposit in Indonesia.
"Discussions are continuing but there is no assurance an agreement will be reached," Barrick said in a statement.
Bre-X said earlier today that the Indonesian government advised Bre-X to form a joint venture with Barrick, which would give Barrick 75 percent of Busang and Bre-X 25 percent.
Neither company said what the terms of the joint venture would be or how much cash or shares would change hands.
The Indonesian government also asked Bre-X and Barrick to consider "a 10 percent participation being given to the Indonesian government," Bre-X said.
The companies have until December 4 to finalize an agreement or else the Indonesian government "will take the necessary steps to prevent delay in the development" of Busang, Bre-X said.
Bre-X said it had asked the Indonesian government if any alternative deal would be acceptable.
